Subject: Operationalizing ISV revenue credits and lead claim windows

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OpenForge is excited about the embedding connector and the potential for joint GTM. We have a few commercial/ops questions from our finance and partnerships teams as we think about a small pilot: 

- Revenue-share: our initial ask is a 20% revenue share on net subscription ARR for deals that originate with an OpenForge lead and purchase Redwood Dedicated. Can you confirm Redwood's usual gross-to-net adjustments (tax, refunds, discounts)?
- Lead registration: we need clarity on the registration window and evidence required to qualify a lead (e.g., HubSpot record id, signed NDA, first purchase order).
- Claim window: what is Redwood's standard lookback for lead-crediting? We'd prefer at least a 180-day window for early-stage pilots, but we can be flexible.
- Retro credits: in case of a late registration claim, is there a cap or clawback approach?

Attached is a redline of a simple term sheet (OpenForge_Redwood_Draft_TermSheet_v1.pdf) that shows our proposed billing flow and sample commissions. Can we set up a 30-minute ops call this week to lock down the mechanics? 

Thanks,

Ashwin Kumar
Head of Partnerships, OpenForge
ashwin@openforge.io | +1 415-555-0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operationalizing ISV revenue credits and lead claim windows

Ashwin — thanks for the note and the draft term sheet, looks like a solid starting point. I'm looping in Marissa (partner ops) and Ben (commercial ops) to work through the operational details.

Quick answers up front:
- Gross-to-net: Redwood applies standard gross-to-net adjustments; we exclude taxes and handle refunds/credits via a quarterly reconciliation. We can share the exact formula.
- Lookback/claim window: our default is 90 days from the first qualified opportunity creation in the partner portal, but for strategic pilots we're open to 180 days with a time-bound pilot clause.
- Evidence: HubSpot record id + an audit trail (initial outreach email thread) is typical. For higher-value deals we require PO or signed MSA.
- Retro credits/clawbacks: we accept retro claims up to the claim window; after that we do not retroactively credit unless there was an internal ops error. We do maintain a 12-month clawback schedule for cancellations.

Can Marissa/Ben propose an ops playbook we can agree on? I can host a 30-min call Thursday at 11am PT.

> Rishi / Ben — draft checklist for partner ops call with OpenForge:
>
> 1) Lead registration process
>   - OpenForge creates lead in partner portal or submits HubSpot record id + evidence email
>   - Claim window: default 90 days; propose pilot 180 days (auto-expire)
>   - Required metadata: lead source, contact email, company domain, estimated ARR, demo date
>
> 2) Commission tiers and timing
>   - Pilot tier: 15% on net ARR up to $250k in ARR; 20% above $250k for 12 months
>   - Payment cadence: quarterly, net 30 after invoice and verification
>
> 3) Retro claims and clawbacks
>   - Retro claims allowed within claim window only; beyond that require COO approval
>   - Clawback: 12-month pro rata on cancellations or refunds; credits offset future partner payments
>
> 4) Evidence & audit
>   - HubSpot id + initial outreach email capture; for high-value deals, PO/MSA required
>   - Redwood will provide quarterly partner ledger export for reconciliation
>
> 5) Exceptions and approvals

Subject: Internal: Ops clarifications before call with OpenForge

Marissa / Ben — a few operational points I want us to be explicit about before we lock the call with Ashwin: 

- Lead registration canonical source: prefer partner portal entry (HubSpot synced). If OpenForge submits a HubSpot id, we need a timestamped email from their rep proving outreach prior to Redwood engagement.
- Claim window structure: agree to offer 180 days for this pilot but add a one-time pilot sunset clause (pilot window closes after 6 months from execution). After pilot, revert to 90-day default unless we formalize longer term.
- Commission tiers: Marissa proposed blended tiers. Ben — can you confirm whether the 20% above $250k is feasible with our gross margin assumptions for Dedicated? Also confirm payment flow (invoice -> verification -> remit).
- Automation: can we add an automated partner ledger export (CSV) every quarter, and a web hook for OpenForge to receive lead acceptance events? If engineering lift is >2 sprints we should mark as roadmap.
- Exceptions: any retro beyond 180 days requires approval by me + finance; keep a paper trail.

Please reply with any redlines; I'll share the proposed playbook with Ashwin after we sync.

Thanks,
Rishi
